finalText:
Redis died at `02:14:07` and never came back. 12 reconnect attempts, all refused, over the next 17 minutes.

Once redis went down, every `api`, `worker`, and `scheduler` request fell back to hitting the store directly. That caused constant cache miss storms and 5 second timeouts on nearly every request from then on. With nothing draining, the request queue grew non-stop, from 52 up to 568 by `02:31`.

The backlog finally used up all the memory. `worker-2` hit an out-of-memory crash at `02:31:44`, and the whole service went down 8 seconds later when the supervisor killed the unresponsive api process group.

**Root cause:** redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections and stayed down. Nothing else recovered from that.

Worth checking why redis was unreachable, and adding a queue depth limit so a stuck redis can't take the whole service down next time.
